data.name: Bullseye Shot
data.description: You slow your breath, calm yourself, and hit the bullseye, just as you were trained to do. You can spend a move action to steady your shot. When you do, you gain a +4 bonus on your next ranged attack roll before the end of your turn.
prerequisites: PRETEXT:Prerequisites: Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, base attack bonus +5.
